all.source_quote: Must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
Must be studying in Classes V-VIII in a government, government-aided, or government-recognized school.
Annual family income should generally not exceed Rs 2.5 lakh.

unmodelled.text: Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal

unmodelled.text: Must have a valid bank account
